price_per_kwh.label: Electricity price per kWh
price_per_kwh.description: In your currency's main unit, e.g. 0.245 for 24.5p. A new price applies from the moment you set it; past costs keep the price they were counted at.

currency.label: Currency symbol
currency.description: Shown in front of costs, e.g. £, $ or €.

psu_rating.label: PSU efficiency rating
psu_rating.description: Your power supply's 80 Plus or Cybenetics rating. Dynamo uses its efficiency curve to turn component watts into watts at the wall.

psu_efficiency.label: PSU efficiency (%)
psu_efficiency.description: Used at every load, for a PSU without a rating or one you have measured.

psu_watts.label: PSU wattage (W)
psu_watts.description: The rated output, e.g. 1000 for an RM1000x. Efficiency depends on load as a share of this, and drops at low loads.

mains.label: Mains voltage
mains.description: PSUs are 1 to 3 points more efficient on 230 V.

options.230: 230 V (UK, Europe, most of the world)

rest_watts.label: Rest of the PC (W)
rest_watts.description: A fixed allowance for everything without a sensor: motherboard, RAM, drives, fans, RGB and USB devices. 30 to 60 W suits most desktops.

warn_watts.label: Warning colour from (W)
warn_watts.description: The bar number takes your theme's accent colour from this draw. 0 turns it off.

high_watts.label: High colour from (W)
high_watts.description: The bar number turns your theme's warning red from this draw. 0 turns it off.
